title: FLA binary import: wire bitmap fills (flash8-import.ts converter)
description:
The binary FLA reader (flash8-binary.ts) already parses bitmap fills correctly into {kind:"bitmap", bitmapId, matrix} — but the flash8-import.ts converter (convertFill) silently discards them with console.warn("bitmap fill not supported") and substitutes solid gray.

The model, canvas renderer, and SWF compiler already support BitmapFill — packages/core/src/engine/renderer.ts line 258 resolves BitmapFill via imageCache, and packages/swf/src/compile.ts calls emitBitmapFillTags. The gap is only in packages/core/src/fla/flash8-import.ts.

## What to implement

1. In convertFill() (flash8-import.ts ~line 85), handle case "bitmap":
   - Map the Fla8 bitmapId (u32 library index) to a library BitmapItem id string. The function already receives libraryIndex→BitmapItem context from the caller chain; thread it through or look up from the existing mediaItemMap.
   - Resolve the matrix (Fla8Matrix → repeat/smooth flags — the matrix encodes tiling mode in its scale).
   - Return a BitmapFill: { type: "bitmap", bitmapId: <libraryItemId>, repeat: <bool>, smooth: <bool> }.
2. Add a unit test in packages/core/src/__tests__/ verifying a round-trip: binary FLA bytes with a bitmap-filled shape produce a BitmapFill in the resulting FlashDocument.
3. Update CLAUDE.md learnings if non-obvious mapping discoveries are made.

## Acceptance
- No more "bitmap fill not supported" console warnings on import of a .fla that uses bitmap fills.
- The imported shape renders with the bitmap pattern in the canvas preview.
- Existing tests remain green.
